<mxfile host="Electron"> <diagram name="trust-boundary" id="0"> <mxGraphModel dx="-674" dy="-155" grid="0" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="0" page="0" pageScale="1" pageWidth="1300" pageHeight="560" background="#0a0f1c" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <mxCell id="title" parent="1" style="text;html=1;align=center;fontFamily=Courier New;fontSize=16;fontStyle=1;fontColor=#dbe4f0;" value="What actually holds the guarantee up — and what still does not" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="30" width="1220" x="40" y="20" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="c1" parent="1" style="swimlane;startSize=38;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;fillColor=#0a1a14;strokeColor=#34d399;fontColor=#34d399;fontFamily=Courier New;fontSize=13;fontStyle=1;" value="ENFORCED BY HARDWARE" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="440" width="390" x="40" y="70" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="c1a" parent="c1" style="rounded=1;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;align=left;spacingLeft=12;fillColor=#0a2b1e;strokeColor=#34d399;fontColor=#dbe4f0;fontFamily=Courier New;fontSize=11;" value="RAM is encrypted by the CPU
(AMD SEV). The cloud operator
cannot read the enclave's memory,
and there is no login to the VM." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="86" width="350" x="20" y="55" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="c1b" parent="c1" style="rounded=1;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;align=left;spacingLeft=12;fillColor=#0a2b1e;strokeColor=#34d399;fontColor=#dbe4f0;fontFamily=Courier New;fontSize=11;" value="Remote attestation: Google signs
a token naming the exact image
that is running. Each owner checks
it BEFORE releasing a secret." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="86" width="350" x="20" y="155" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="c1c" parent="c1" style="rounded=1;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;align=left;spacingLeft=12;fillColor=#0a2b1e;strokeColor=#34d399;fontColor=#dbe4f0;fontFamily=Courier New;fontSize=11;" value="Transport is untrusted by design.
Every file crossing Google Drive is
end-to-end encrypted and signed, so
a hostile pipe yields denial of service
at worst — never disclosure." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="100" width="350" x="20" y="255" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="c1d" parent="c1" style="text;html=1;align=center;fontFamily=Courier New;fontSize=12;fontStyle=2;fontColor=#34d399;" value="Verify, do not trust." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="26" width="350" x="20" y="375" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="c2" parent="1" style="swimlane;startSize=38;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;fillColor=#1a1508;strokeColor=#d7b357;fontColor=#d7b357;fontFamily=Courier New;fontSize=13;fontStyle=1;" value="ENFORCED BY POLICY" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="440" width="390" x="455" y="70" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="c2a" parent="c2" style="rounded=1;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;align=left;spacingLeft=12;fillColor=#2e250f;strokeColor=#d7b357;fontColor=#dbe4f0;fontFamily=Courier New;fontSize=11;" value="Dual consent. Both data owners read
the auditor's eval code and sign off.
Either one can veto. The job will not
start until every approval is in." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="86" width="350" x="20" y="55" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="c2b" parent="c2" style="rounded=1;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;align=left;spacingLeft=12;fillColor=#2e250f;strokeColor=#d7b357;fontColor=#dbe4f0;fontFamily=Courier New;fontSize=11;" value="Immutability. A private input is frozen
on first receipt, so no owner can swap
in a different model or benchmark after
the code has been approved." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="86" width="350" x="20" y="155" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="c2c" parent="c2" style="rounded=1;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;align=left;spacingLeft=12;fillColor=#2e250f;strokeColor=#d7b357;fontColor=#dbe4f0;fontFamily=Courier New;fontSize=11;" value="Scorecard-only egress. The enclave
emits raw responses; the verdict is
assigned outside it, so no API key and
no network ever enters the sealed room." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="100" width="350" x="20" y="255" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="c2d" parent="c2" style="text;html=1;align=center;fontFamily=Courier New;fontSize=12;fontStyle=2;fontColor=#d7b357;" value="Rules, not physics — configured at deploy." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="26" width="350" x="20" y="375" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="c3" parent="1" style="swimlane;startSize=38;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;fillColor=#140b0f;strokeColor=#e06c75;fontColor=#e06c75;fontFamily=Courier New;fontSize=13;fontStyle=1;" value="STILL TRUST — our open problems" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="440" width="390" x="870" y="70" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="c3a" parent="c3" style="rounded=1;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;align=left;spacingLeft=12;fillColor=#2c1218;strokeColor=#e06c75;fontColor=#dbe4f0;fontFamily=Courier New;fontSize=11;" value="You trust the chip vendor and the
cloud. A cloud CVM's trust model is
weaker than the ideal one, and a
hardware break breaks everything." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="86" width="350" x="20" y="55" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="c3b" parent="c3" style="rounded=1;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;align=left;spacingLeft=12;fillColor=#2c1218;strokeColor=#e06c75;fontColor=#dbe4f0;fontFamily=Courier New;fontSize=11;" value="Approved code can still leak. Nothing
stops eval code that smuggles the
benchmark out through its own outputs
except a human reading it first." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="86" width="350" x="20" y="155" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="c3c" parent="c3" style="rounded=1;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;align=left;spacingLeft=12;fillColor=#2c1218;strokeColor=#e06c75;fontColor=#dbe4f0;fontFamily=Courier New;fontSize=11;" value="Side channels are out of scope.
Timing and memory-access patterns
during inference can carry information
about the prompts. We have not
defended against that." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="100" width="350" x="20" y="255" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="c3d" parent="c3" style="text;html=1;align=center;fontFamily=Courier New;fontSize=12;fontStyle=2;fontColor=#e06c75;" value="Named on purpose, not hidden." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="26" width="350" x="20" y="375" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>

div.div: What actually holds the guarantee up — and what still does not

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe center; width: 388px; height: 1px; padding-top: 79px; margin-left: 11px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: center; color: #34d399;
display: inline-block; font-size: 13px; font-family: 'Courier New'; color: #34d399; line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; font-weight: bold; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;
display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 336px; height: 1px; padding-top: 158px; margin-left: 44px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #dbe4f0;
display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: 'Courier New'; color: #dbe4f0; line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
RAM is encrypted by the CPU
(AMD SEV). The cloud operator
cannot read the enclave's memory,
and there is no login to the VM.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 336px; height: 1px; padding-top: 258px; margin-left: 44px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #dbe4f0;
display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: 'Courier New'; color: #dbe4f0; line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
Remote attestation: Google signs
a token naming the exact image
that is running. Each owner checks
it BEFORE releasing a secret.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 336px; height: 1px; padding-top: 365px; margin-left: 44px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #dbe4f0;
display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: 'Courier New'; color: #dbe4f0; line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
Transport is untrusted by design.
Every file crossing Google Drive is
end-to-end encrypted and signed, so
a hostile pipe yields denial of service
at worst — never disclosure.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe center; width: 1px; height: 1px; padding-top: 442px; margin-left: 205px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: center; color: #34d399;

display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe center; width: 388px; height: 1px; padding-top: 79px; margin-left: 426px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: center; color: #d7b357;
display: inline-block; font-size: 13px; font-family: 'Courier New'; color: #d7b357; line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; font-weight: bold; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;
display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 336px; height: 1px; padding-top: 158px; margin-left: 459px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #dbe4f0;
display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: 'Courier New'; color: #dbe4f0; line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
Dual consent. Both data owners read
the auditor's eval code and sign off.
Either one can veto. The job will not
start until every approval is in.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 336px; height: 1px; padding-top: 258px; margin-left: 459px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #dbe4f0;
display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: 'Courier New'; color: #dbe4f0; line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
Immutability. A private input is frozen
on first receipt, so no owner can swap
in a different model or benchmark after
the code has been approved.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 336px; height: 1px; padding-top: 365px; margin-left: 459px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #dbe4f0;
display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: 'Courier New'; color: #dbe4f0; line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
Scorecard-only egress. The enclave
emits raw responses; the verdict is
assigned outside it, so no API key and
no network ever enters the sealed room.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe center; width: 1px; height: 1px; padding-top: 442px; margin-left: 620px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: center; color: #d7b357;
display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: 'Courier New'; color: #d7b357; line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; font-style: italic; white-space: nowrap;

div.div: Rules, not physics — configured at deploy.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe center; width: 388px; height: 1px; padding-top: 79px; margin-left: 841px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: center; color: #e06c75;
display: inline-block; font-size: 13px; font-family: 'Courier New'; color: #e06c75; line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; font-weight: bold; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;
display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 336px; height: 1px; padding-top: 158px; margin-left: 874px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #dbe4f0;
display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: 'Courier New'; color: #dbe4f0; line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
You trust the chip vendor and the
cloud. A cloud CVM's trust model is
weaker than the ideal one, and a
hardware break breaks everything.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 336px; height: 1px; padding-top: 258px; margin-left: 874px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #dbe4f0;
display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: 'Courier New'; color: #dbe4f0; line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
Approved code can still leak. Nothing
stops eval code that smuggles the
benchmark out through its own outputs
except a human reading it first.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 336px; height: 1px; padding-top: 365px; margin-left: 874px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #dbe4f0;
display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: 'Courier New'; color: #dbe4f0; line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
Side channels are out of scope.
Timing and memory-access patterns
during inference can carry information
about the prompts. We have not
defended against that.
